_meta.audit_scope: 7 pairs declared by handoff packet F-AUDIT-STANDARDS-SPRAWL candidate list
_meta.doctrine_principle_audited_against: P9_no_sprawl (every concept has ONE canonical home; cross-references are pointer + 1-line summary, never restatement)

pair_findings.overlap_description: Standard names the 12-layer enum and BNF role token; ADR-0056 is the authoritative source for these. Standard does not currently cite ADR-0056 in frontmatter (cites ADR-0015/0017/0053/0054). Standard's §2-3 likely restates the layer enum that ADR-0056 declares — restatement risks drift.
pair_findings.recommended_slim: (a) Add ADR-0056 to clean-architecture.md frontmatter `related_adrs`; (b) replace any redeclaration of the 12-layer enum with a 1-line cite + pointer to ADR-0056§Decision; (c) keep layer semantics + cross-layer contract rules + testing posture in the standard (these are NOT in ADR-0056 — they're the standard's unique contribution).

pair_findings.overlap_description: ci-lanes.md is human-readable mirror of registry/quality/lanes.yaml (catalogs the lanes that actually run in CI). hyperscaler-gates.json defines HG-* CLAIM-DISCIPLINE gates (when may we claim hyperscaler-grade behavior). Different artifact roles: lanes catalog vs. claim authority overlay.
pair_findings.recommended_slim: None. Optional cross-cite: ci-lanes.md may add a section pointing to hyperscaler-gates.json for which lanes provide evidence for which HG-* gate.

pair_findings.overlap_description: api-design.md is TECHNICAL (wire formats, URL conventions, HTTP methods, headers). ADR-0037 is LIFECYCLE (preview/stable/GA tiers, semver-diff gate, deprecation timeline, SDK gen). Different scopes. api-design.md§1 mentions schemas in `contracts/` per ADR-0011 — light cross-reference, not restatement.
pair_findings.recommended_slim: None. Optional: add explicit cite to ADR-0037 in api-design.md frontmatter so the lifecycle/stability decision is discoverable from the technical spec.

pair_findings.overlap_description: agent-instructions-discipline.md is a deep-dive on ONE aspect of docs/AGENTS.md (the <!-- agent-instructions:start --> fence shape + banned-token grep rules). Proper specialization, not sprawl. AGENTS.md cites companion_docs.
pair_findings.recommended_slim: None. Pair is the canonical example of correct standard-vs-meta-contract relationship.

pair_findings.partner: Data Boundary engine specs (no specific path declared by handoff)
pair_findings.overlap_description: data-class.md defines the class taxonomy (public/internal/tenant-config/tenant-data/pii/phi etc.) + cross-pillar flow matrix + DSR cascade hooks. Program-level scope (consent tiers, regulator mappings) lives in docs/PRIVACY-PROGRAM.md per data-class.md§intro. No specific implementation 'Data Boundary engine spec' was identified in current /specs/ tree — likely implementation lives in crates/oya-shared-data-boundary-* or similar. Class names are the authoritative source.
pair_findings.recommended_slim: None. If a Data Boundary engine PRD-spec gets authored at /specs/ later, this standard should remain the class-taxonomy authority and that PRD should cite it.

pair_findings.overlap_description: dependency-policy.md = POLICY (LTS pinning rules, license posture, cargo-vet/deny, Renovate baseline, provider-SDK strategy). dependency-rationales.json = PER-DEP DATA (rationale + owner + layer seam + replacement strategy per dep). Policy authors rules; registry instantiates them per dep. Zero overlap.
pair_findings.recommended_slim: None. Pair is the canonical example of policy ↔ data registry separation.

pair_findings.overlap_description: error-handling.md is the SOLE authority on Rust error-handling discipline (thiserror enums + anyhow at top-level binaries + .unwrap() prohibition + silent-failure rule). Frontmatter cites ADR-0053/0052/0054 (grit-related, not error-handling). No dedicated error-handling ADR exists.
pair_findings.recommended_slim: None. The standard IS the canonical source. Optionally file a FixupTask to author an ADR formalizing the thiserror/anyhow tier decision so it's traceable in the decision log.
pair_findings.fixuptask: F-AUTHOR-ADR-ERROR-HANDLING-TIER-DECISION (low priority; standard is currently canonical authority)
